meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Dan.1.3
§ Ashpenaz = "I will make prominent the sprinkled"
chief eunuch of Nebuchadnezzar

elsewhere.note: The king spoke to Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles;
